description_en: Enables a cron job in PolarClaw
description_zh: 用于启用PolarClaw中的定时任务功能
kebab_example: aliyun polardb enable-polar-claw-cron-job --application-id pa-00000000000000 --job-id 0ee00f56-f467-4d41-858c-ca4ede2c770e --restart true --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnablePolarClawCronJob

parameters.description_en: The ID of the cron job to enable.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the cron job to enable
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to restart the gateway after the job is enabled. The default value is `true`.
parameters.description_zh: 创建后是否重启网关，默认true
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to restart the gateway after the job is enabled. The default value is `true`
parameters.help_zh: 创建后是否重启网关，默认true
parameters.name: restart
